# Code review: spending-limit token selector (`114d0c4...HEAD`)

This was a full review: all nine areas, with the top findings checked twice. It covers committed changes only: 19 files, +2149 −1, base 114d0c4 → HEAD 7bbf775. The untracked `.claude/skills/code-conventions/` and `docs/engineering/` were left out.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Verdict** | Ready to open the PR. Nothing blocks. Four quick fixes are worth making first. |
| **Score** | **93 / 100**, estimated rather than computed with the exact formula. 6 of 12 findings were checked by a validator/refuter pair. |
| **Held it down** | A misleading "No tokens found" message on the error path, a doc comment that contradicts the code, and long comments that break the repo's comment rule. |
| **Fix first** | BUG-001, KIS-002, CNV-001 |

**Checking:** 6 of 12 findings checked · 6 confirmed · 0 contested · 0 refuted · 2 promoted from deferrals.

**Since your last run:** there's no earlier run for this range. The saved `last-run.tsv` is from a different change (address book), so there's nothing to compare, and I didn't overwrite it because you asked for read-only.

## Scores by area (worst first)
| Area | Score | Findings |
|---|---|---|
| Conventions | 86 | CNV-001, CNV-003 |
| Bugs | 88 | BUG-001 |
| Performance | 88 | PRF-001, PRF-002 |
| Testing | 90 | TST-001, TST-002 |
| DRY | 92 | DRY-001, DRY-002 |
| KISS | 92 | KIS-001, KIS-002, KIS-003 |
| Security | 100 | none |
| Regression | 100 | none (the codegen change only adds, and the `.schema-hash` matches `schema.json`) |
| Architecture | 100 | none |

## What this review did not cover
- **Popular-token addresses** (`popularTokens.ts:19-92`): I compared all 55 against the canonical deployments I know and none looked wrong. That was from memory, though, not a scripted check against the chain or the Transaction Service.
- Tests weren't run and nothing was built, as you asked. The Base UI behaviour was checked by reading the cached `@base-ui/react@1.2.0` source.
- `TokenSelector` isn't used anywhere in the app yet (only stories and tests), so real-flow integration wasn't checked.
- The bugs pass ended with a stray "security: 3 findings" line. Its body had exactly one finding (BUG-001), and that's what I counted.

## Fix before opening (all P3, all quick)

**BUG-001 · "No tokens found" shows next to the load-error message** (checked: confirmed)
`…/SpendingLimitFlow/TokenSelector/index.tsx:208`
- **Problem:** The empty-state check only looks at the two loading flags, not `isError` or `isPopularError`.
- **When it happens:** The held-balances load fails, and the list is also empty — either the chain has no popular list and hides the native token, or a search matches nothing. The user then sees "Couldn't load this Safe's tokens" and "No tokens found" at the same time. The empty message is `ComboboxEmpty`, which Base UI shows off `data-empty` (`filteredItems.length === 0`).
- **Fix:** Add `&& !isError && !isPopularError`, and add a test with `options: []` plus an error flag set.

**KIS-002 · The `isLoading` doc comment contradicts the code** (checked: confirmed)
`…/SpendingLimitFlow/hooks/useSpendingLimitTokenOptions.ts:17`
- **Problem:** The comment says "Always false while the query is skipped". But when `trusted === undefined` and the Safe is valid, `skip` is true (line 61) and `isLoading` is also true (line 98). The test at `useSpendingLimitTokenOptions.test.ts:223-231` asserts exactly that.
- **Fix:** Reword it to say `isLoading` is also true while the token-list setting is still resolving.

**CNV-001 · Comment blocks break the repo's comment rule** (checked: confirmed, with a narrower scope)
- **Rule:** `AGENTS.md:79` says one line max, no multi-paragraph blocks, and no comments that justify a change to the reviewer.
- **Clear violations:**
  - `popularTokens.ts:1-16`: 16 lines, 4 paragraphs, cites WA-3149/AC C14 plus a verification date and method.
  - `hooks/useSpendingLimitTokenOptions.ts:35-46`: cites WA-3146/#8646.
  - `TokenSelector/index.tsx:71-76` and `:122-124`: cite WA-3149 and AC C15.
  - `TokenSelector/TokenOptionRow.tsx:7-12`: cites WA-3150.
  - `utils/tokenOptions.ts:88-91`: cites AC C14/C16.
- **Weaker cases:** `useSpendingLimitTokenOptions.ts:54-56, 58-59, 96-97` and `index.tsx:90-91` are multi-line but give real reasons that the code can't express. Shortening them is enough.
- **Fix:** Cut each to one line and move ticket/AC traceability into the PR description.

**CNV-003 · An export used only by tests is missing the `_` prefix** (promoted from a KISS deferral, not checked by agents)
`…/SpendingLimitFlow/hooks/useSpendingLimitTokenOptions.ts:30`
- **Problem:** `buildIdentityKey` is only exported for its test. `apps/web/docs/code-style.md:39` says test-only exports get a `_` prefix, and 68 exports in `apps/web/src` follow that.
- **Fix:** Rename it to `_buildIdentityKey`, or stop exporting it and test it through the hook.

## Worth a ticket, or fix when the selector gets wired in

| ID | Location | Issue | Checked |
|---|---|---|---|
| PRF-001 | `hooks/useSpendingLimitTokenOptions.ts:63-66`, `TokenSelector/index.tsx:138-149` | All held tokens are fetched (no paging, no `excludeSpam`) and rendered with Base UI's default `limit=-1`. The DOM grows with the Safe's whole token history. It's only a real problem when the user has picked "All tokens" (the default is trusted, so likelihood is L2). Fix: pass a `limit` to `<Combobox>`. | confirmed |
| PRF-002 | `TokenSelector/index.tsx:141-145` | `filter`, `itemToStringValue` and `onValueChange` are inline arrows. Base UI 1.2.0 memoises `filter` and `filteredItems` on those references (`AriaCombobox.js:149-160, 200-252`), so the full list is rescanned on every re-render. Fix: `useCallback`, or hoist them to module level. | confirmed |
| DRY-001 | `TokenSelector/TokenGroupState.tsx:28-47` | Rebuilds the icon + message + `RotateCw` retry pattern that `components/common/InlineRetryError` already provides. You can't swap it straight in: `InlineRetryError` is a full-width Alert card with no `className` or `testid` prop, so it would need a compact variant first. | confirmed (fix corrected) |
| TST-001 | `TokenSelector/index.tsx:208` | No test sets only one of `isLoading` / `isPopularLoading` with `options: []`, so a `!(a && b)` slip would pass. | no |
| TST-002 | `hooks/useSpendingLimitTokenOptions.ts:99` | The held `isError` isn't tested with stale `currentData` present, unlike `isPopularError` (`:102`). The bugs pass found no current way to trigger it: no polling, and `refetch` is only reachable from the error state. | no |
| DRY-002 | `utils/tokenOptions.ts:12-18, 46-51` | `PopularToken` and `NativeCurrencyInfo` are near-duplicate types (the second just lacks `address`). Promoted from a deferral, low confidence. | no |
| KIS-001 | `TokenSelector/TokenOptionRow.tsx:16` | A nested ternary tests `symbol` and `name` twice, once with `&&` and once with `\|\|`. An if-chain would read more easily. Minor enough to leave out of the score. | no |
| KIS-003 | `utils/tokenOptions.ts:30` | The comment says `group` decides "whether a balance is shown", but no balance is rendered anywhere (WA-3150 will add it). Minor enough to leave out of the score. | no |

## Worth tidying while you're in these files
1. **`apps/web/AGENTS.md:88`:** the "New utility/service" row says `utils.test.ts` colocated, but 86% of feature utility tests live in `__tests__/`, which this diff correctly follows. This is a pre-existing doc fix in a file the diff doesn't touch, so it's not scored.

That's 1 proposal, about 1 line. I left it alone: fixing it means editing a tracked file, and this run is read-only.

## Ruled out
- **Retry `<Button>` submitting a surrounding form:** the popup renders through a portal, outside any form.
- **Selection reset when leaving and returning to the same Safe:** no concrete trigger found.
- **NaN sort on `fiatBalance`:** the backend always sends a numeric string.
- **`useTokenListSetting` and `useChainId` disagreeing:** both resolve through `useChainId`.
- **Untrusted metadata or XSS:** everything renders as React text, and the logo goes through the existing `TokenIcon`.
- **Codegen tag or `cgwApi` export collisions:** none.
- **Mobile impact:** `tokens.ts` isn't re-exported and mobile doesn't use it.

**How this was produced:** nine review passes ran in parallel. For the top 6 findings, one agent tried to confirm each and another tried to refute it. The last 6 are low-priority and count at full weight without being checked. No files were changed, nothing was installed, no tests ran, and nothing was posted.
